
{{alias}}( arr, names, fields )
    Converts a list of nested arrays to "tidy" data sets.

    The function assumes that all nested arrays have the same length.

    The number of field names should equal the length of each nested array.

    Parameters
    ----------
    arr: ArrayLikeObject<ArrayLikeObject<ArrayLikeObject>>
        List of nested arrays.

    names: Array<string>
        Data set names.

    fields: Array<string>
        List of field names.

    Returns
    -------
    out: Array<DataSet>
        List of data sets.

    Examples
    --------
    > var a = [ [ 1, 2 ], [ 3, 4 ] ];
    > var b = [ [ 5, 6 ], [ 7, 8 ] ];
    > var out = {{alias}}( [ a, b ], [ 'data1', 'data2' ], [ 'x', 'y' ] )
    [ <DataSet>, <DataSet> ]

    See Also
    --------
